_comment: Pinned model weights. Baked into the image at build (/opt/models) and seeded into a bind-mounted ./models at container start. sha256 is enforced; add a new model here, never by hand-copying onto hosts.
_comment_bundled: Fine-tuned models committed in models_bundled/ (not hosted anywhere): copied, never downloaded. Replace the file AND its sha256 here together. Strip training state first (ultralytics.utils.torch_utils.strip_optimizer) so each file stays well under GitHub's 100 MB limit.
_comment_rfdetr: monitor_person_rfdetr.pth (monitor_tamper, 135 MB) is over GitHub's 100 MB limit, so it is NOT bundled: copy it into each host's ./models/ (it is in /data/cctv_dev/cctv/script-server/scripts/detection/models/ on the H200 host). monitor_tamper logs 'unavailable' without it.
